about: Backgrounds: where a person comes from (use background) or what they do for a living (use profession). attributes and gold are Orsino's; skills, gear, offers, routine and contact (an old acquaintance somewhere in a generated region, who hears news through a channel and passes it on) are what the background means in a Kyr world. gold is in Orsino gold pieces; Kyr pays one coin per ten.

contact.text: {contact} and {member} hunted the same hills for a season.

source.notes: Orsino gives stats and gold only; Kyr adds woodcraft (reading animals) and a coil of rope.

contact.text: {contact} and {member} nursed the sick together through a hard winter.

source.notes: Orsino starting gear "bandages" and "herbs" are not in its gear catalog; Kyr defines them. Mending sets bones and binds wounds.

contact.text: {contact} once bought {member}'s work and asked no questions about it.

source.notes: Orsino gives stats and gold; Kyr adds lockwork (Orsino pickLock skill) and thieves' tools from the Orsino gear catalog.

contact.text: {contact} walked a surveyor's road with {member} years ago.

source.notes: Orsino starting gear "map"; Kyr gives the map meaning: a company with wayfinding knows the region's roads before walking them.

contact.text: {contact} worked the same seam as {member} before taking the inn.

source.notes: Orsino gives stats and gold; Kyr adds digging (faster earth-moving) and a shovel from the Orsino gear catalog.
Orsino gives stats and gold; Kyr makes the profession offer lodging and keep its owner at their workplace.
Orsino gives stats and gold; Kyr adds mending and a routine. What the herbalist sells is authored per person.
